rics.description: Wages, Average, Staff and workers in urban units, Current Prices, Wages & Earnings, Annual, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, China
rics.meaning: China Wages: Wages, Average, Staff and workers in urban units, Current Prices, Wages & Earnings, Annual, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, China. Wage data by sector or category.
rics.how_to_use: China publishes wages by urban formal-sector (above-designated-size firms). Migrant worker wages tracked separately by Ministry of Human Resources. Real-wage growth tracks productivity + inflation; recent slowdown reflects deflation.
